note: Treed, gated RV park in a non-profit society's year-round recreation area (ski hill, tube park, bike park) 12 km south of Grande Prairie near the Wapiti River. Long-term full-service sites run year-round; an overnight/weekend area of power-and-water sites with a group pavilion runs May 15 - Sep 27. Self-contained RVs only; no tents. Marketed to working adults near job sites. --Claude
